newsitem.title: USA: Vulcan sees strong aggregates market.
newsitem.headline: Vulcan sees strong aggregates market.

text.p: Vulcan Materials Co said Wednesday it expects the market for construction aggregates to remain strong in 1997.
Demand in all major construction end-use markets should equal or exceed 1996 levels, with the exception of residential construction, which is expected to decline modestly, the company said.

Continuing strong demand for construction aggregates and improved earnings from Chemicals' Performance Systems Business Unit were the primary drivers of improved performance in 1996, the company said.

Taking all current expectations into account, the company said it thinks there is a good chance Vulcan's 1997 net earnings and earnings per share will equal 1996's record results. The company assumes 1997 earnings in its Construction Materials segment will equal or exceed 1996's record result.
The outlook for caustic soda prices remains uncertain and comparisons to 1996 are likely to be significantly unfavorable, particularly in the first half of 1997, the company said.

Demand in all major construction end-use markets should equal or exceed their 1996 levels, with the exception of residential construction, which is expected to decline modestly, the company said. Based on this outlook, the company expects 1997 earnings in its Construction Materials segment to equal or exceed 1996's record result.
